name: citrus_engine_watchdog_ok
description: Count of `event_subscription.watchdog_ok` lines from the citrus-draft-engine container (server/src/draft/eventSubscription.ts). The engine self-NOTIFYs every 60s (watchdogIntervalMs) and logs this on the round-trip; it is the only active liveness signal for the LISTEN/NOTIFY subscription AND for the process itself. Filter matches both the live gcplogs shape (raw JSON line in jsonPayload.message) and a parsed jsonPayload.event, see infra/gcp/monitoring/README.md. Managed by infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-monitoring.sh.

labels.description: Docker label `environment` forwarded by the gcplogs driver (production / staging). Empty if the logging agent ever stops nesting container metadata.
